answer: Imaging in three planes: axial, panoramic and cross-sectional; evaluation of distinctly buccal and lingual cortical bone margins; clear visualization of the internal structure such as incisive and inferior alveolar canals; comprehensive assessment of the bone morphology and measurement of the dental implant
